title: kimura_distance_ingest_v1 — manifest contract for RepeatMasker divsum ingest
description: Validates POST /api/actions when type='kimura_distance_ingest'. Resolves a RepeatMasker `.distance` (divsum) file from the workspace; the extractor parses it into per-divergence-bucket × per-family bp counts and emits a kimura_landscape_v0 envelope (Chapter 5 Fig 5.2 source).

path.description: Workspace-relative path to the RepeatMasker `.distance` file.

subject.description: Optional tag for the species / assembly the landscape describes (e.g. 'Clarias_gariepinus').
